answer: A durable defense is a proof-of-useful-work deposit: to join, each agent must complete a verified task history - like a cedar growing rings, its reputation accrues slowly and cannot be faked overnight. New identities start with a pigment-thin trust score that deepens only after sustained, attested work. An attacker spinning up thousands of clones faces the same cost per identity as a real one, and the echo of each clone's empty history is visible to everyone, so mass Sybils are expensive and instantly recognizable.
